title: Azure GPU VM Prices per Hour by Region
subtitle: Every Azure GPU VM size and region: on-demand, Spot, savings plans, weekly
description: Microsoft Azure list prices per hour for every GPU virtual machine size (NC, ND, NG and NV series) in every region, from Microsoft's public Azure Retail Prices API, checked every Monday. Linux and Windows pay-as-you-go, Spot, and the 1-year and 3-year savings-plan rates the API lists, plus GPU count, GPU model and GPU memory from Microsoft Learn for the sizes Microsoft documents (blank for the others). Source code, checks and history: https://github.com/datameaning-dm/dm-azure-gpu-prices. Explained at https://www.datameaning.com/guides/azure-gpu-vm-prices/. List prices only: no disks, network, egress or negotiated discounts.
